intent: Advance the NovaPulse engine from Phase 4 to Phase 5 by implementing a procedural wave survival system, environmental hazards, and enhanced telemetry.
architecture_impact: Introduces new domain-specific modules (WaveDirector, Arena) and expands the ECS capabilities to support complex environmental interactions and boss-level combat mechanics.
key_modifications: {'file': 'src/ai/wave_director.js', 'change_summary': 'Created a new procedural wave management system to control enemy spawning and game progression.'}
{'file': 'src/environment/arena.js', 'change_summary': 'Implemented dynamic arena boundaries and environmental hazards like black holes and laser gates.'}
{'file': 'src/ecs/world.js', 'change_summary': 'Enhanced entity querying to support both bitmasks and component class arrays for more flexible system processing.'}
{'file': 'src/combat/weapons.js', 'change_summary': 'Added boss-specific turret weapon logic to support higher-tier combat encounters.'}
{'file': 'src/core/loop.js', 'change_summary': 'Integrated hardware telemetry tracking into the main game loop for performance monitoring.'}
functionality_gained: The engine now supports structured wave-based survival gameplay, hazardous environmental obstacles, and improved debugging/telemetry capabilities for performance analysis.
